notes: A collaboration that is filed under the other artist's name now shows up in New Releases: a credit is read as every name it carries, so pinning one artist finds the track they are credited second on.

A fake or mis-filed release can be deleted: hold it for two seconds, press Delete in the sheet that opens, and it leaves every New Releases surface with an Undo behind it. A tap still opens the release as before.

The album reorder sheet opens after two seconds instead of three, and it opens on the song you held - that row is scrolled into view and lit for a moment instead of the sheet starting at the top of the album.
